title: Lenny's Podcast Search
cardDesc: Semantic search engine for 300+ Lenny's Podcast episodes using hybrid retrieval (dense + BM25) with cross-encoder reranking.

sections.title: Problem
items: Lenny's Podcast has 300+ episodes with invaluable product/growth wisdom
YouTube's native search is keyword-based and misses semantic meaning
No way to find specific insights across all episodes or jump to exact timestamps

sections.title: Solution
items: Built a semantic search engine using hybrid retrieval (dense vectors + BM25)
Speaker-turn aware chunking preserves Q&A context from host-guest conversations
Cross-encoder reranking surfaces the most relevant passages
Deep links jump directly to the exact YouTube timestamp

sections.title: Technical Highlights
items: Hybrid retrieval: OpenAI embeddings + BM25 sparse vectors fused with RRF
BGE Reranker cross-encoder for final precision ranking
Qdrant vector store with indexed payload fields for fast filtering
Contextual chunk enrichment using Claude Haiku for better embeddings

sections.title: Bonus Feature
items: Idea Constellation: Interactive graph visualization of 200+ key ideas
Ideas clustered by theme with connections showing similar/contradictory viewpoints
Filter by company (Airbnb, Stripe, etc.) to see insights from specific guests
